name: Gusion
source:
He is so clever that there is the saying 'no devil can solve problems that Gusion cannot solve.'

He himself acts irritated and always makes biting remarks. But if you look closely, he always solves all the problems that he is asked to solve.

He is lean, but also has superhuman strength alike the devils from Mammon's camp.
